newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Suharto thanks Mahathir over Timor meeting.
newsitem.headline: Suharto thanks Mahathir over Timor meeting.

text.p: Indonesia's President Suharto thanked Malaysia for the break-up of a conference in Kuala Lumpur on the troubled territory of East Timor, Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said on Monday.
The two leaders met at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit.
"President Suharto said thank you to me the moment he saw me, and that was to be expected," Mahathir told a news conference after the daylong summit.

Pro-government youth groups stormed a conference organised by human rights' activists on November 9 in the Malaysian capital which had been planned to condemn Indonesian rule of the former Portuguese colony.
